title: A set on which the projection to an n-plane is locally co-Lipschitz lies in countably many Lipschitz images of ℝⁿ
statement: Let N, n ∈ ℕ, let Q be a linear subspace of ℝ^N = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N) with finrank Q = n and orthogonal projection q = Q.starProjection, let E ⊆ ℝ^N, C ∈ ℝ and δ > 0, and assume |y − x| ≤ C |q(y − x)| for all x, y ∈ E with |y − x| < δ. Then there are maps F_0, F_1, F_2, … : ℝⁿ → ℝ^N (ℝⁿ = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)), each Lipschitz (with some constant K_i ≥ 0), such that E ⊆ ⋃_i F_i(ℝⁿ).
lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Rn N)) (E : Set (Rn N)) (C δ : ℝ), finrank ℝ Q = n → 0 < δ → (∀ x ∈ E, ∀ y ∈ E, ‖y - x‖ < δ → ‖y - x‖ ≤ C * ‖Q.starProjection (y - x)‖) → ∃ F : ℕ → Rn n → Rn N, (∀ i, ∃ K : ℝ≥0, LipschitzWith K (F i)) ∧ E ⊆ ⋃ i, Set.range (F i)
